newsitem.title: GHANA: SOCCER-WEAH GOAL KEEPS LIBERIA'S WORLD CUP HOPES ALIVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEAH GOAL KEEPS LIBERIA'S WORLD CUP HOPES ALIVE.

text.p: Former World footballer of the year George Weah kept Liberia's slim hopes of World Cup qualification alive on Sunday with a solo effort that gave his war-shattered country a 1-0 victory over Egypt.
Weah broke from deep inside his own half to score the only goal of the match from a thunderous 20-metre drive in the 29th minute.
Liberia, who played their home leg in Ghana's capital Accra because of strife back home, trail group two leaders Tunisia by five points. The two sides meet in Tunisia at the end of April.
Most of the Liberian squad arrived in Accra too late for training on Saturday.
"The boys were very together even though we had had no time to train. Good teamwork, and they worked very hard," Weah's personal assistant Sylvester Williams said.
